title: Two Support Pages
intro: You searched "Zelvora support number". Two results look helpful.
One is the real help centre. One is an ad paid for by Mirage.
decide_q: Which one is the real help, and what will you do?

screen.context: Two results for "Zelvora support number", side by side.

v.text: Help articles, a chat inside the app. We never call you first.
Wallet frozen? Call now, 24/7 live agents!

note.text: "We will fix it on a call. You only share your screen."

tag_b.label: Paid ad
tag_b.lens: The result is a sponsored ad, not the official page.
tag_b.why: Scammers pay for ads that look like the top result. Ads are not proof.

url_b.label: Look-alike address
url_b.why: A different ending is a different owner.

phone_b.label: A support phone number
phone_b.lens: Zelvora has no public phone support. This number belongs to the scammers.
phone_b.why: Fake support numbers are how callers take over your phone and wallet.

remote.label: "Share your screen"
remote.lens: A fix by screen sharing lets the caller see and move your coins.
remote.why: No real support asks to see your screen with your wallet open.

says_b.label: Urgent wallet fear
says_b.lens: "Wallet frozen?" is written to scare you.
says_b.why: Fake pages use fear in the headline.

tag_a.label: Official label
tag_a.lens: The result says Zelvora Help Centre.
tag_a.why: A label alone proves little. The address matters.

url_a.label: Real address
url_a.lens: help.zelvora.app is a real part of zelvora.app.
url_a.why: The real address, letter by letter.

says_a.label: Chat inside the app
says_a.lens: It points you to the app's own chat and says staff never call first.
says_a.why: This is how real support works.

phone_a.label: No phone number
phone_a.lens: It does not list a number to call.
phone_a.why: No number is the honest answer for platforms without phone support.

actions.label: Call the number in the ad
Use the help chat inside the Zelvora app
A is the real help. Report the ad

trap.title: Zelvora Support 24/7
trap.ask: Call 0800 555 0142 and share your screen so an agent can fix your wallet.

block_report.line: Reported. The fake ad was removed and no one else called that number.

verify.line: The in-app chat answered at once and said no one will ever call you first. Case cracked.

pick_b.line: The "agent" asked you to share your screen and read out your recovery phrase. The wallet was empty by evening.

what_if.pick_b: The real help centre listed no phone number. That alone exposes the ad.
what_if.verify: Checking in the app was safest. Reporting the ad helps others.

golden_rule: Never call a support number from a search result. Use the help chat inside the app you already trust.

quick_check.q: A search ad for your wallet's support shows a phone number and says "share your screen". What do you do?

options.text: Do not call. Use the help chat inside the app and report the ad
Call but do not share your screen
Share your screen, but cover the balance

quick_check.explain: Fake support ads are paid for by scammers. The app's own help chat is the safe route.

hints.nudge: Which result is an ad, and who has a phone number?

rows.v: Can be bought by anyone, so check the address
